source_refs.note: Topic 9.3.5 (PDF 216, printed 213). Short question 5 is answered.

blocks.text: Pitching your idea well helps you get the support needed to turn it into reality; whether for a small business or a big project, a good pitch can make all the difference.

blocks.prompt: Explain the importance of a business pitch (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: It wins the money, partners and customers an idea needs: a clear, persuasive pitch convinces investors to fund it and others to support or buy it.

items: A good pitch wins support, funding and customers.
